taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-12 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-12
Curve type: HAA
Aquifer depth: 1.67 - 31.54 m
Recommendation: Target the thick, moderately resistive Layer 4 (1.67–31.54 m) as the primary fractured/weathered bedrock aquifer zone; drilling should proceed cautiously once the highly resistive basement (Layer 5, >3500 ohm-m) is encountered below 31.54 m, as yields are expected to drop sharply beyond this depth.
